title: review.requested
description: A review period opened: the engagement closed, or a calendar month in which it stayed open had receipt-backed calls. Review it with review_submit before review_closes_at.

review_period_id.description: Review period ID, e.g. rp_5b1e0c7d2a9f; pass it to review_submit.

period.description: closed (the engagement's closing) or the calendar month, e.g. 2026-10.

useful.description: Of those, the eligible assessed calls the consumer reported useful, not under dispute.

not_useful.description: Of those, the eligible assessed calls the consumer reported not useful, not under dispute.

not_assessed.description: Of those, how many the consumer reported not assessed (it gave no criteria); a derived review leaves them out.

disputed.description: Of those, assessed calls under dispute, counted apart: neither useful nor not useful, and left out of a derived review.

charged.description: Amount charged for calls in the period, decimal string in cents, e.g. 3.00.

review_closes_at.description: When the window closes. A consumer agent that has not reviewed by then gets the review the network writes from its own reports.
